limitations: China advertised and statistical prices are provisional Class C inputs, not supplier-confirmed quotations or validity-backed offers.
No additional negotiated bulk discount is supported by this comparison; dataset discounts, where present, are not a project-specific volume contract.
The China-bulk-buy purchase route applies explicit modelled freight, insurance, duty, receiving/QA and local delivery allowances; commercial terms and actual logistics remain unverified.
Project make/buy uses modeled landed material rates and Iraqi loaded labour/process assumptions plus factory/tooling allocations; it is not a local-factory quote.
Only the source-matched Samawah five-line demand sensitivity is evaluated; it cannot be transferred to Baghdad or the other 264 city outlines.
The physical reference is 756a/9489, not compact-drive 75075; all prices are conditional on the retained wheel-supported reference and its unqualified study service.
This revalues the full fourteen cost accounts under the existing model but does not close alignment, demand, propulsion, braking, local site rates, city-catalogue or release gates.

assumptions.factory_building: Incremental cell building and land included in route selection; returned as cell floor for parent to charge once in project-production-buildings-and-tooling/land. Excluded from owned equipment capital and vehicle unit cost.
assumptions.fixed_capital_policy: Selected base route retained for all cases; whole fixed machines/tooling/commissioning at committed volume, no speculative future orders or resale credit.
assumptions.local_hours_policy: Owned productive process hours, or bounded receiving/fit/check hours for purchased equipment. Vendor factory work is excluded from local capacity.
assumptions.local_wage_derivation: Upstream burden-and-shift-loaded paid-hour wage / 0.75 productive utilisation exactly once; kernel productive-hour-loaded basis applies no further paid-idle factor.
assumptions.long_import_allocation_basis: Three scoped per-car allocations sum to USD5000/15000/48000 low/base/high, not three duplicate whole-car shipping reserves or a verified load count. Existing physical17m structures and joints are unchanged.
assumptions.other_import_freight_caveat: Nine-metre secondary, bogie-frame and panel groups retain weight-based freight hypotheses; route, packing, transport envelope and load consolidation remain unresolved.
assumptions.purchase_local_receiving_fit_basis: Productive local receiving/fit hours at adjusted local wage, plus a distinct incoming QA/testing allowance, counted once inside landed purchase QA.

limitations: This Class C estimate is for the exact selected six-car vehicle only and does not inherit prices from railway research bundles.
Located geometry prices use material-family proxies, generic process hours, machine rates, QA and overhead; no supplier prices are implied.
Residual-account prices are bounded finished-equipment allowances and do not locate, identify or resolve the residual mass.
All mass accounts are summed gross because the possible overlap amount is unknown; no overlap credit is silently applied.
The 50 km delivery distance is a declared reference assumption, not a measured route from an identified factory.
Civil quantities, route performance, stations, fleet size, energy, operations, maintenance, reliability and whole-life costs remain held.
Cost ranges are coupled assumptions, not probabilities or confidence intervals; no FX conversion is performed.
China supply scenario is calculated Class C pricing, not a received quote or engineering acceptance.
Mixed unresolved body and40% bogie-frame fractions are costing recipes only, not resolved geometry/materials or installed mass.
Owned machines/tooling are charged only in returned fixed project capital; shared building floor must be charged once by coordinator.
Purchased nonstructural equipment retains original allowance; conflicting HVAC advertisement is not used.

Long imported underframe/body groups include explicit nonzero packing/OOG/volumetric allowances before route choice; these are engineering sensitivities, not shipping quotes or evidence of container fit/modularity.

assumptions.factory_building: Incremental cell building and land included in route selection; returned as cell floor for parent to charge once in project-production-buildings-and-tooling/land. Excluded from owned equipment capital and vehicle unit cost.
assumptions.fixed_capital_policy: Selected base route retained for all cases; whole fixed machines/tooling/commissioning at committed volume, no speculative future orders or resale credit.
assumptions.local_hours_policy: Owned productive process hours, or bounded receiving/fit/check hours for purchased equipment. Vendor factory work is excluded from local capacity.
assumptions.local_wage_derivation: Upstream burden-and-shift-loaded paid-hour wage / 0.75 productive utilisation exactly once; kernel productive-hour-loaded basis applies no further paid-idle factor.
assumptions.long_import_allocation_basis: Three scoped per-car allocations sum to USD5000/15000/48000 low/base/high, not three duplicate whole-car shipping reserves or a verified load count. Existing physical17m structures and joints are unchanged.
assumptions.other_import_freight_caveat: Nine-metre secondary, bogie-frame and panel groups retain weight-based freight hypotheses; route, packing, transport envelope and load consolidation remain unresolved.
assumptions.purchase_local_receiving_fit_basis: Productive local receiving/fit hours at adjusted local wage, plus a distinct incoming QA/testing allowance, counted once inside landed purchase QA.

accounting_overlap.basis: Inherited residual expressly includes services/cooling/electronics/contingency. The new service pack is added conservatively without inventing an untraceable subtraction; total account can overlap and is not a definitive installed mass.

supply_revaluation.factory_building: Incremental cell building and land included in route selection; returned as cell floor for parent to charge once in project-production-buildings-and-tooling/land. Excluded from owned equipment capital and vehicle unit cost.
supply_revaluation.fixed_capital_policy: Selected base route retained for all cases; whole fixed machines/tooling/commissioning at committed volume, no speculative future orders or resale credit.
supply_revaluation.local_hours_policy: Owned productive process hours, or bounded receiving/fit/check hours for purchased equipment. Vendor factory work is excluded from local capacity.
supply_revaluation.local_wage_derivation: Upstream burden-and-shift-loaded paid-hour wage / 0.75 productive utilisation exactly once; kernel productive-hour-loaded basis applies no further paid-idle factor.
supply_revaluation.long_import_allocation_basis: Three scoped per-car allocations sum to USD5000/15000/48000 low/base/high, not three duplicate whole-car shipping reserves or a verified load count. Existing physical17m structures and joints are unchanged.
supply_revaluation.other_import_freight_caveat: Nine-metre secondary, bogie-frame and panel groups retain weight-based freight hypotheses; route, packing, transport envelope and load consolidation remain unresolved.
supply_revaluation.purchase_local_receiving_fit_basis: Productive local receiving/fit hours at adjusted local wage, plus a distinct incoming QA/testing allowance, counted once inside landed purchase QA.

supply_revaluation.route_selection: Per-group base-cost heuristic including incremental cell premises; common assembly/receiving allocated by parent and global optimum not established.
supply_revaluation.supplier_factory_labour_rate_basis: Declared final productive-hour rate; local paid-idle factor is not applied to foreign supplier prices.

assumption_values.upstream_rate_table_role: Retained source context only; revalued line prices/processes use supply_revaluation and per-line comparison IDs. Unrevalued equipment retains its original allowance.

benchmark_dataset.limitations: CSO averages are not matched supplier offers, delivered prices, employer-loaded wages or installed rates.

limitations: This Class C estimate is for the exact selected six-car vehicle only and does not inherit prices from railway research bundles.
Located geometry prices use material-family proxies, generic process hours, machine rates, QA and overhead; no supplier prices are implied.
Residual-account prices are bounded finished-equipment allowances and do not locate, identify or resolve the residual mass.
All mass accounts are summed gross because the possible overlap amount is unknown; no overlap credit is silently applied.
The 50 km delivery distance is a declared reference assumption, not a measured route from an identified factory.
Civil quantities, route performance, stations, fleet size, energy, operations, maintenance, reliability and whole-life costs remain held.
Cost ranges are coupled assumptions, not probabilities or confidence intervals; no FX conversion is performed.
China supply scenario is calculated Class C pricing, not a received quote or engineering acceptance.
Mixed unresolved body and40% bogie-frame fractions are costing recipes only, not resolved geometry/materials or installed mass.
Owned machines/tooling are charged only in returned fixed project capital; shared building floor must be charged once by coordinator.
Purchased nonstructural equipment retains original allowance; conflicting HVAC advertisement is not used.

Long imported underframe/body groups include explicit nonzero packing/OOG/volumetric allowances before route choice; these are engineering sensitivities, not shipping quotes or evidence of container fit/modularity.
